subject.title: [Security] Path traversal validation bypass in secret-file.ts with relative path injections

question: Can any untrusted plugin-controlled value reach the ACP `--token-file` or `--password-file` reader, or are those paths exclusively selected by the local operator?
rationale: The answer determines whether there is an exploitable trust-boundary violation, a separate caller bug, or no vulnerability in the secret-file reader itself.

options.title: Confirm CLI-only boundary
options.body: Trace the callers, document the operator-selected path contract, and close after focused tests confirm encoded strings are never decoded into traversal.

options.title: Repair untrusted caller
options.body: If plugin-controlled input reaches this reader, enforce separator-aware canonical containment at that caller's owned sandbox root and add exploit regression coverage.

options.title: Request private reproducer
options.body: Ask the reporter for the exact plugin configuration, ACP invocation, platform, encoded payload, and disclosed file before selecting a repair boundary.

recommendation.title: Confirm CLI-only boundary
recommendation.body: Trace the callers, document the operator-selected path contract, and close after focused tests confirm encoded strings are never decoded into traversal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related secret-file security hardening provides the strongest available ownership signal for deciding the intended filesystem boundary.
